facts.fact: 落地后 Jack 解释那是 Daff 的能力——凡是「有机」者都要避免与她皮肤直接接触
facts.anchor: “It’s her power,” Jack explained. “You want to avoid skin-to-skin contact. If you’re, you know, organic.”

facts.fact: Jack 把学者给他们的圆柱体压进了那扇巨大圆门的插槽
facts.anchor: Jack produced the cylinder the scholar had given them and pressed it into the slot in the door.

facts.fact: Adam 深吸一口气，从背包里取出了 Binder 家族的 grimoire
facts.anchor: Adam took a long breath and removed the Binder family grimoire from his backpack.

facts.fact: Jack 跪下敲击地板，确认整个地方是一台机器——不，是一台计算机
facts.anchor: “I think you’re right,” Jack said. He knelt to rap the floor. “It’s a machine, the whole place—no, a computer.”

facts.fact: Adam 向机器提出查询：他们想了解精灵宗教（elven religion）
facts.anchor: “We wish to learn about the elven religion,” Adam said.

facts.fact: Adam 失去了时间感，Jack 至少花了 an hour 才读完
facts.anchor: Adam lost track of time, but it had to be at least an hour before Jack finished.

facts.fact: Jack 宣布他找到了「他们」不想让他们知道的东西
facts.anchor: “I think I found what they didn’t want us to know.”

facts.fact: Jack 判断机器守卫的话是 Hindi——随即改口 Sanskrit——他并不真会说，而是把它翻译成 binary 来交流
facts.anchor: “It’s Hindi . . . no, Sanskrit,” Jack said. “I don’t really speak it but I’m translating it to binary. I don’t know how well I’m doing.”
